author: potuz
content: There's something that may actually suck in the UX of the builder API cc <@346498651553660928> if this already sufaced. Do existing builders in the devnet already check the signed auth? I realized that the URL we use to sign can be a bit problematic. Examples are "http" vs "https" or "builder/" vs "builder".  A single trivial mistake here and the auth could be ignored by the builder.
